_meta.description: Curated known-good festival dates used to cross-check the Festival & Vrat rule engine (services/festivals) resolution against an established published Panchang for the same location/year/scheme.
_meta.source: drikpanchang.com (Drik Ganita method, Lahiri ayanamsa) — an established published Panchang
_meta.tolerance_policy: A resolved date must fall within ±1 civil day of the reference. Sources can headline a festival on a different sunrise than the engine's udaya-vyApti pick when the defining Tithi spans a sunrise only marginally (Vriddhi) — a one-day spread here is a known, accepted divergence between published Panchangs, not an engine defect. See docs/accuracy-tolerances.md.
